verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a pre-implementation 'structured plan' step (codegen-docs-22) and PR state controls including draft/ready_for_review (codegen-docs-40), which could be used as an approval gate, but agents are documented to create PRs directly/automatically (codegen-docs-24, codegen-docs-32) rather than surfacing a diff for approval prior to PR creation. missing for 10: explicit diff-review-and-approve-before-PR workflow, evidence of a UI/CLI step where a raw diff is shown pre-PR, hands-on confirmation this gate is used in practice.
